title: Commercial Parking Requirements
previewText: In mixed buildings, the underlying parking requirements shall apply, except that for the purposes of determining the parking requirement for commercial uses other than uses listed under Offices in Use Group VII, the equivalent of 0.5 floor area ratio, or the amount of non-office commercial floor area in the building, whichever is less, may be deducted from the floor area used to determine such commercial parking calc
